valuation.method: Forward EV / Adjusted EBITDA (FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA viewed at the 12-month target date, less projected net debt, divided by projected diluted shares)

bear.driver: Slower LNG and power-demand project ramp with elevated growth capex ($7.3B-$7.9B in 2026) weighing on leverage
bear.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA $8.80B at 12.5x EV/EBITDA ($110.00B EV), less $31.50B net debt / 1,245M shares

base.driver: Steady execution toward management's 11%+ long-term Adjusted EBITDA CAGR from the $8.3B-$8.5B FY2026 guidance base
base.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA $9.35B at 13.5x EV/EBITDA ($126.23B EV), less $31.00B net debt / 1,240M shares

bull.driver: Accelerated Transco expansions, Haynesville gathering volumes, and behind-the-meter AI data center power contracts
bull.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA $9.80B at 14.8x EV/EBITDA ($145.04B EV), less $30.50B net debt / 1,239M shares

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA ($9.35B) and $31.00B projected net debt, the $69.09 close implies 12.5x EV/EBITDA; named-analyst targets ($82-$103, clustering around $85-$86) imply ~14.7x-14.8x base FY2027E EBITDA or ~$10.2B FY2027E EBITDA at 13.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of EV/EBITDA moves the base target by $7.54 (10.9 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA vs. $8.3B-$8.5B guidance, 2027 Adjusted EBITDA guidance, and year-end net debt-to-Adjusted EBITDA (~3.75x target)

analyst_notes: Following WMB's Q3 2026 earnings release on November 2, 2026, covering analysts overwhelmingly reiterated Buy/Overweight ratings with targets ranging from $82 to $103 (averaging ~$85-$86), though Goldman Sachs trimmed its target from $84 to $82 on November 13. The ~13-14 pp gap between Street targets and our $76.80 base case (+11.2% upside) reflects higher assumed EV/EBITDA multiples (~14.7x vs. 13.5x) or faster 2027 EBITDA realization from data-center power and Transco projects.
